name: Slider
usage: Volume and zoom, opacity, price and size ranges in filters

props.name: step
props.description: Step between values; `null` allows only the values in `marks`.

props.name: marks
props.description: Labels under the track: value → text.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the handle(s), when there is no visible label.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id of the element that labels the slider.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: Id of the element that describes the slider, such as a hint.

props.name: id
props.description: Id of the slider (Form.Item sets it).

modes.title: Single value (default)
modes.description: One handle; `value`, `defaultValue` and the callbacks use a number.

props.name: range
props.description: Picks a range `[start, end]` with two handles instead of one value.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called while the value changes, including during dragging.

props.name: onChangeComplete
props.description: Called once when dragging ends or a key changes the value, such as to save it.

modes.title: Range: `range`
modes.description: Two handles; `value`, `defaultValue` and the callbacks use a pair `[start, end]`, with `start <= end`.

props.name: range
props.description: Picks a range `[start, end]` with two handles instead of one value.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called while the range changes, including during dragging.

props.name: onChangeComplete
props.description: Called once when dragging ends or a key changes the range.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: Drag the handle, or focus it with `Tab` and use the arrow keys.

examples.name: Variants
examples.title: Range, marks and steps
examples.description: `range` picks a start and an end; `marks` labels values and `step={null}` only allows the marked values.

examples.name: WithInput
examples.title: With a number input
examples.description: When the exact value matters, put an InputNumber next to the slider.
